wishesText.mum: To my dear husband and love, I am so grateful for having you in my life. I wish you many years in good health and prosperity. Happy birthday, my love.
wishesText.family: Happy birthday to our dear loving Father and Husband. May you have a wonderful birthday in good health and long life.
wishesText.alex: Happy birthday, Martin. We haven't always been close, but you've still been a father figure in my life, and I'm grateful for that. I hope you have a really good day and a year filled with health, peace and good moments.
wishesText.michael: Happy birthday, Martin. Thank you for being a steady presence over the years. You didn't have to be, but you were — and that means something. Wishing you a wonderful birthday and a good year ahead.
wishesText.sylvia: Happy birthday, Martin. You've been like a father to us in your own way, and I appreciate that more than I probably say. I hope this year brings you good health, happiness and many reasons to smile.
